protocol.claim: Determine a tested lower bound or reproducible operational boundary for simultaneous market WebSockets from one observed egress; no assumption that a timeout is an IP connection cap.
protocol.address_family: IPv4 first, automatic family selection disabled
protocol.success: Both valid book snapshots on every requested socket, OPEN state, at least one PONG per socket, PONG age <=15 seconds, no unexpected close or error during hold
protocol.stop_policy: Stop on explicit overload/throttling, non-recoverable close/error, exhausted transport budget, or local resource guard
protocol.hold_policy: Fixed wall-clock window, replace lifecycle retirements and report population dips
protocol.market_selection: All markets ranked by observed Gamma volume24hr descending, eligible binary only
protocol.lifecycle_policy: Retire unavailable/resolved markets with recorded evidence; replace and report every population dip without restarting the observation
protocol.frame_recording: All initial snapshot frames and PONGs, then at most one update frame per connection per ten seconds
